address: Shop 15, GF, Block A, Ho Shun Yee Building, 9 Fung Yau Street East, Yuen Long, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: There’s just one item on the menu – double-steamed egg white custard with milk, boasting a silky runny centre under a firmer crust. Order the chilled ones if you’re in a rush, or wait patiently as the hot ones are made to order....
